highmoon_upstream.finding: Project page states HighMoon is licensed under the GNU GPL, but provides no per-asset attribution.

openoffice_historical_license.finding: OpenOffice.org source code and binaries up to and including 2 Beta 2 were dual licensed LGPL/SISSL; from 2 Sep 2005 the 2.0 codeline moved to LGPL only.

openoffice_licensing_faq.finding: Prior OpenOffice versions used LGPL 2.1; 1.x also SISSL. This is product-level evidence, not a per-WAV provenance certificate.

qnetwalk.finding: QNetWalk is GPL-2.0 and its README says current sounds were taken from LBreakout2. This does not prove the ultimate origin/license of the 2002 connect.wav sample.

os4depot_qnetwalk.finding: QNetWalk connect.wav: 3056 bytes, LHA CRC d93d, timestamp 24 Feb 2002.

os4depot_highmoon.finding: HighMoon package is labeled GPL/distributable; archived asset listing carries original HighMoon file sizes.
